summary.text: Michael Walbom is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Matthew Sergent.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Air Force veteran who served from 1986 to 2010.

paragraphs.text: Walbom was born in Lorain, Ohio, and graduated from the University of Central Missouri in 2016, according to Ballotpedia.
He was the Democratic nominee for District 57 in 2024, when Republican incumbent Rodger Reedy defeated him in the general election.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as retired and said the state's business is passing laws to make Missouri economically competitive and to protect individual rights, agriculture, education and justice.
